name: raceoff
description: RaceOff: a shared-screen miniature kart racer you play with your phone as the controller

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @raceoff/server" "npm run dev -w @raceoff/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @raceoff/web && npm run build -w @raceoff/server
